NOW: Kilusang Bayan Kontra Kurakot (KBKK) coalition holds press briefing for the upcoming ‘Protestang Bayan Kontra Kurakot’ anti-corruption protest on November 30 in Luneta, Manila. 

The group plans to organize another massive protest to call for accountability from corrupt government officials. They point to Pres. Marcos Jr. and VP Sara Duterte as chief culprits in corruption scandals ranging from confidential funds to flood control projects. 

KBKK invites the public to join the November 30 protest in Luneta and continue the call for systemic change.

The Yellowidiots always make it appear that their enemies are avoiding being charged and jailed for corruption. Such is the excuse of MLQ3 for Duterte winning in 2016 with the support of GMA. Never mind that Abnoy failed miserably in his presidency. 

It was MLQ3 also who first predicted that the second Marcos administration might become a repeat of the second Marcos administration; the scions of mortal enemies becoming president and failing at it. Ninoy didn't become president which is where his son has him beat. 

Going by the approval and trust ratings, Abnoy has an edge over Marcos. The same is true with the economy but Aquino inherited the fruits of GMA's reform measures. Marcos inherited the pandemic debt and all that came with it. The economic crisis now is largely due to corruption, with funds earmarked for infrastructure projects diverted to election and flood control projects from where the legislators derive their share of stolen loot from contractors and DPWH officials. 

MLQ3 is happy that the INC rally didn't call for the ouster of the president outright unlike Edsa 3 where they provided some of the warm bodies but it fizzled out. 

Now that we have is a waiting game. Who's going to be on Santa's naughty list that Christmas; meaning who will be arrested by the dealing touted by the Ombudsman? 

There's a list but Boying is checking it twice and most likely will add to it. We will soon find out. 

Meantime, brace yourselves for an unhappy new year. The economy will get worse before it gets better.
